# elan1 — The Agentic Transformation Company

> elan1 builds governed agentic business applications. Ten agentic apps on one control plane, ten industry configurations, and a human approval gate on the actions that commit your business.

## What elan1 is

elan1 is an agentic transformation company. It provides a governed platform of agentic business applications — the 1 Suite — on one control plane (enterprise1), with a human approval gate on consequential actions and a hash-chained audit of what happened.

Built on Claude by Anthropic. Ad-free, pixel-free.

## The 1 Suite — ten agentic apps in five categories

### Revenue (win the customer)
- [sales1: Agentic CRM](https://elan1.ai/products/sales1)
- [market1: Agentic marketing](https://elan1.ai/products/market1)

### Service (keep the customer)
- [service1: Agentic customer service](https://elan1.ai/products/service1)

### Trade (move the goods)
- [commerce1: Agentic eCommerce and POS](https://elan1.ai/products/commerce1)
- [supply1: Agentic supply chain](https://elan1.ai/products/supply1)

### Works (run the company)
- [finance1: Agentic finance](https://elan1.ai/products/finance1)
- [people1: Agentic HR](https://elan1.ai/products/people1)
- [project1: Agentic project and PSA](https://elan1.ai/products/project1)

### Compass (see what happened and set where to go)
- [insight1: Agentic analytics](https://elan1.ai/products/insight1)
- [goal1: Agentic goal management](https://elan1.ai/products/goal1)
